verdict.rationale: An email service could plausibly offer in-product AI insights such as summaries or smart categorization, so this axis applies to Fastmail. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any AI-generated insights or suggestions. Community users say they miss Gmail-style auto-categorization and package or boarding-pass summaries in Fastmail, which points to absence rather than presence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
